Policies & Terms

Motion is free, stores your data on your device by default, and never sells it. Last updated: October 2025.

Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how Motion (“we”, “us”, the app) handles your personal data. It is written to comply with India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and general international privacy expectations. Using the app in guest mode requires almost no data sharing at all — details below.

1. Who we are

Motion is a personal productivity web application operated by TIHAM 777, Chittagong, Bangladesh. Contact: tihamyt07@gmail.com.

2. What data we handle

a) In guest mode (no account): everything you create — tasks, time blocks, notes, journal entries, habits, guidelines and settings — is stored only in your own browser (localStorage). It never leaves your device unless you use an online tool described in section 5.

b) If you sign in with Google: we receive from Google your email address, display name, profile photo and a unique account ID. We use these solely to sign you in and label your sync data.

c) If you enable cloud sync: the content you create (tasks, notes, habits, and other app data, including AI chat history) is uploaded to your private sync store (Google Firebase) so it follows you across devices. We also store a short device label (e.g. “Phone”/“Computer”), a truncated browser user-agent and timestamps to keep syncs consistent.

d) What we never collect: we run no advertising, no analytics, no tracking pixels, no behavioural profiling, and we never sell or rent any data.

3. Why we process data (purpose limitation)

  • To provide the app’s core functions (storing and showing your own content back to you).
  • To authenticate you and sync your data across your devices only after you affirmatively consent at sign-in.
  • To keep the service working (fraud prevention, abuse detection, technical diagnostics are limited to what is strictly necessary).

4. Data minimisation

We only ask for data the app genuinely needs: guest mode needs nothing; sign-in needs your Google identity; sync needs your content. Sign-in requests only your basic Google profile (name, email, photo) — the app never asks for access to your Google Drive or other Google data.

5. Third-party services (processors / tools)

Some features rely on external services. Each only receives the minimum needed for that feature:

  • Google Firebase (Authentication, Firestore) — sign-in and cloud sync, if you sign in.
  • Google Fonts — font files; your browser requests them directly (your IP is visible to Google during that request).
  • cdnjs / jsPDF — the library used for PDF export.
  • Translator tool — text you type is sent to Google Translate / MyMemory to produce the translation.
  • QR code tool — text you type is sent to the goqr.me (api.qrserver.com) API to render the QR image.
  • Currency tool — requests exchange rates from open.er-api.com (no personal data sent).
  • AI Assistant / AI Hub — only if you add your own API key: your prompts and content are sent directly to the provider you choose (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek, Groq, Cohere, Perplexity, Together, OpenRouter or a custom endpoint) and are governed by that provider’s privacy policy. Your API keys are stored only in this browser.

These providers may process data outside Bangladesh. We do not transfer your data to any advertiser, data broker or analytics company.

6. Storage, retention & security

Local data lives in your browser until you delete it (Settings → data tools, or by clearing site data). Cloud sync data is retained until you delete it in the app or request erasure. We keep up to three short-lived pre-sync safety backups to protect you against accidental data loss. All traffic uses HTTPS; Firebase data is encrypted in transit and at rest. No system is perfectly secure — please don’t store information in the app that could endanger you if exposed.

7. Your rights (DPDP Act)

You have the right to: access a summary of your data and how it’s processed; correct or complete inaccurate data; erase your data; nominate someone to exercise rights if you’re incapacitated or deceased; and grievance redressal. You can exercise most of these yourself instantly: Settings → Data tools (export, clear), sign out, or clear browser data for this site. For anything else, write to us at tihamyt07@gmail.com — we respond within thirty (30) days.

8. Children

Motion is a general productivity tool and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly process children’s personal data and we run no tracking or targeted advertising directed at any user, of any age. If you believe a child has provided data, contact us and we will delete it.

9. Withdraw consent

You may withdraw consent at any time: sign out, revoke Motion’s access in your Google Account settings, or clear the app’s data in your browser. Withdrawal does not affect processing already lawfully completed.

10. Changes

We may update this policy; the “Last updated” date above will change and significant updates will be surfaced in the app before they take effect.

Terms & Conditions

These Terms govern your use of Motion. By using the app — as a guest or with an account — you accept them.

1. The service

Motion is a free, browser-based personal productivity app (time blocks, tasks, habits, notes, guidelines, focus timer, AI assistant integration). We may add, change or remove features at any time.

2. Eligibility & accounts

You must be at least 18 years old, or use Motion with a parent/guardian’s consent. Accounts use Google Sign-In. You are responsible for keeping your Google account secure; we can’t be liable for losses from someone else using your device or account.

3. Your content

Everything you write in Motion stays yours — you own your content. You grant us only the limited technical right to store, sync and display it back to you as needed to run the app. You are responsible for what you store and for having the right to use it.

4. AI features

AI features run through third-party providers using your own API keys. Outputs are generated by those providers, may be inaccurate, and must not be relied upon as professional, medical, legal or financial advice. Your use of each provider is also governed by their terms.

5. Acceptable use

  • Don’t use Motion for anything unlawful, fraudulent or abusive.

  • Don’t use Motion to store or distribute content that infringes others’ rights.

6. Intellectual property

The Motion app — its design, code and branding — belongs to TIHAM 777. All third-party names, logos and trademarks (Google, Firebase, OpenAI, etc.) belong to their owners and are used only to describe compatibility.

7. Disclaimer & limitation of liability

Motion is provided “as is” and “as available” without warranties of any kind. We don’t promise uninterrupted or error-free service, and we are not liable for data loss, lost profits or indirect damages arising from your use of the app. Your data is stored in your browser and cloud account — please keep your own backups (Settings → Backup & Restore). Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.

8. Termination

You may stop using Motion anytime — just clear your browser data or delete the app from your device. We may suspend abusive accounts or take the service offline at any time (it’s a free, best-effort app).

9. Governing law

Cookie & Storage Policy

Short version: Motion sets no advertising or tracking cookies, runs no analytics, and embeds no ad networks. Here’s exactly what we use instead.

1. Local storage (essential)

The app stores your tasks, notes, blocks, habits, guidelines, settings and preferences in your browser’s localStorage under ft_* keys. This is strictly necessary for the app to work at all — without it, nothing could be saved between visits. It is readable only by Motion on your device.

2. Cookies

Motion itself sets no cookies. If you use Google Sign-In, Google’s sign-in flow (on accounts.google.com) uses its own cookies as part of authentication — those are governed by Google’s policies, and the session token Firebase keeps in your browser is needed to keep you signed in.

3. Third-party requests

Your browser contacts these services only when the related feature is used: Google Fonts (fonts), cdnjs (PDF export library), Firebase (only when signed in or syncing), the Translator, QR and Currency tools (see the Privacy Policy, section 5). The AI assistant contacts your chosen AI provider only when you send it a message with your own API key configured.

4. No tracking, ever

We don’t use Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Mixpanel, Hotjar, session recording, fingerprinting, advertising SDKs or any other tracker. There is nothing to opt out of, because there is nothing tracking you.

5. Managing storage

You can view, export or delete everything from Settings → data tools, or wipe all Motion data via your browser’s site-data settings. Clearing storage erases local guest data permanently — export first if you want a copy.

Refund Policy

Motion is completely free. There are no purchases, subscriptions, in-app payments or fees of any kind today — so there is normally nothing to refund.

1. Today (free app)

All features are free. You will never be asked for payment details. If you ever see a payment prompt claiming to be Motion, it is not us — please report it to tihamyt07@gmail.com.

2. If paid features are ever introduced

Any future paid features will clearly show price, billing terms and a refund policy at the point of purchase, and this page will be updated before the first charge is possible. Nothing will be charged without your explicit action.

3. Digital content & applicable law

Any future paid digital services will honour refund rights available under India’s Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules and the DPDP Act, including withdrawal where applicable. Nothing in this policy limits your statutory consumer rights.

4. Questions / disputes

Billing questions (past or future): tihamyt07@gmail.com. We respond within thirty (30) days.
